summary: All configured Checks pass (build/vet/test exit 0) and the Revision can fast-forward origin/master, but the experiment fingerprint does not bind the production Kernel under test. evals/scripts/plan_experiment.py evaluator_digest() hashes only evals/cases.json, experiment-space.json, run-experiment.sh, assert_results.py, Dockerfile, runtime, and iron_forest_eval; the experiment_fingerprint payload includes only variant, cases, attempts, contender configs, and evaluator_digest, while source_revision is recorded but not hashed. A Go/Kernel/tool change therefore leaves completed fingerprints unchanged, so plan_experiment can reject every candidate with no unique contender remains and never re-evaluate the changed Kernel. evals/scripts/affected_role.py is not wired into any workflow, and README states the model evals workflow runs affected-role trials on pull requests even though evals-model.yml has no pull_request trigger. Required: include the production source/binary digest in the experiment fingerprint (or otherwise invalidate on Kernel/tool/harness changes), and wire affected_role into the PR path or correct the README.
